workflow.limits: Headless synthetic native features; no GUI button/task/preview or Onshape parity claim. Physical disconnect and native C++ networking not intercepted. Only additive sweep/loft and feature patterns are covered.
workflow.persistence_note: FreeCAD 1.1.4 restores deprecated AttacherEngine display text from Engine 3D to Engine Plane for Attacher::AttachEnginePlane and uses the filename as document display label. The five ordinary workflows compare every other object intent field exactly. The angled-plane case retains all original/raw-native/managed values, checks authored inputs exactly, and compares only the measured read-only hidden Pad.Placement output against an independent raw native open; blank Body/Plane map-version displays must agree with their authoritative stored native maps. No quaternion rounding or intent-field deletion is used.
